description: Documentation only. A webring, in its owner's repo. Owning a ring doesn't need a site. A site is a member only when it is listed in `members` AND its own repo has an app.sonasky.apollo.ringMember record pointing at this ring; members' sites then always show previous/index/next ring links in their footer.

main.description: rkey is the ring's slug (lowercase letters, numbers, dashes), used in its URL /@owner/ring/<slug>.

body.description: Content of the ring's index page, sanitized like page bodies.

theme.description: rkey of an app.sonasky.apollo.style in the owner's repo. Falls back to the owner's site theme.

members.description: Invited sites, in ring order (previous/next walk this list).
